description_full: OBIC Business Consultants Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures solution technologies and related products for enterprise operations in Japan. The company offers packaged software for accounting, personnel, and payroll, and related peripheral operations. It also provides cloud services. The company was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
ceo_bio: Mr. Shigefumi  Wada CPA | President & Representative Director | Age 73 | Compensation: $766,158 (FY2026)

CEO compensation is 3× revenue per employee (modest relative to workforce productivity). Governance score flags moderate compensation governance risk (5/10).
financial_summary: OBIC Business Consultants Co., Ltd. is a mid-cap technology business with a $4.6B market cap on $324M of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +11% over the past three years, a respectable pace for a business of this size.
Returns on capital run at 105% against a 10% cost of capital — a 95-point spread that is the clearest signature of an economic moat. Gross margins of 83% confirm genuine pricing power.

The business throws off $100M in free cash flow — roughly 31 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, with adequate 0.96× cash conversion.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year.

Shareholder yield is only 1.1%, a thin return of capital, and insiders hold 62% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is, and within its sector the business captures 2.0× its fair share of profits, a structural advantage visible in the numbers.
